summary: OpenAI launched a ChatGPT for small business program offering training, in-person academies, guides, and partner integrations (Dropbox, Shopify, Intuit, Slack, Atlassian, Wix) built on ChatGPT Work and GPT-5.6.

practices.reason: The program introduces plugins and skills from third-party partners that a team could explore for small-business workflows, but no technical integration details are given.
practices.quote: Explore plugins, skills, and special offers from a curated list of partners most useful to small businesses, including Dropbox, Shopify, Intuit, Slack, Atlassian, Wix, and more.
